title: D2C-Routing: Dimension-to-Composition Evidence Routing for Mixed-Origin AI-Generated Text Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.27380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-generated text detection is commonly framed as a binary document-level judgment about whether a text is human-written or machine-generated. This framing breaks down for mixed-origin writing, where content origin and expression origin may differ. We cast mixed-origin detection as dimension-to-composition source attribution, inferring content origin and expression origin before composing them into four collaboration types. We propose Dimension-to-Composition Routing (D2C-Routing), which routes content-side and expression-side evidence to supervised dimension heads before a learned gated composition layer predicts the final label. translated_title: D2C-Routing：面向混合来源AI生成文本检测的维度到组合证据路由
translated_abstract: AI生成文本检测通常被构建为关于文本是人工撰写还是机器生成的二元文档级判断。这种框架在混合来源写作中失效，因为内容来源和表达来源可能不同。我们将混合来源检测视为维度到组合的来源归属问题，在推断内容来源和表达来源后，将其组合成四种协作类型。我们提出维度到组合路由（D2C-Routing），该方法在内容侧和表达侧证据被路由到监督维度头之前，通过一个学习到的门控组合层预测最终标签。在MixD2C（从HART混合来源基准重建的分割）上，我们公开的基于D2C-Routing的检测系统达到0.8603的四路平均TPR@1%FPR，比同分割的RACE本地重跑高6.5个百分点。核心消融实验支持路由设计，而错误分析显示区分AI与人类在混合场景中的挑战。
tldr: 本文提出D2C-Routing方法，通过将内容来源和表达来源分离推断并组合，显著提升了混合来源AI生成文本的检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes D2C-Routing, which separately infers content and expression origins before composing them, significantly improving mixed-origin AI-generated text detection performance.
